title: Carry one request deadline through ordinary task-sync local phases
outcome: The caller's deadline bounds data-worktree admission, export and import and is checked before a new Git, folder or SQLite effect.
acceptance: A behavioral test with budget injection proves expiry before admission or import causes a typed refusal without launching further Git queries or changing the folder or store.
In-flight or unknown outcomes preserve recovery. Honor the caller's limit without adding a shorter nested hard limit or a second warning policy.
